name: Sahajanand Medical Technologies
summary: Surat-based maker of cardiac stents and structural-heart devices (TAVI, occluders); ~25% share of India's drug-eluting stent market, ~39% revenue from Europe.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹1,211 Cr (+18%), PAT ₹69 Cr (5.7% margin); FY24 was a loss
positives: Real product franchise with 16% revenue CAGR and improving margins
red_flags: 53x P/E vs 44x peers on thin 14% EBITDA margin
Net debt/EBITDA 4.9x; Q1 operating cash flow negative
100% OFS with PE funds exiting; Delhi Police and CBI notices seeking documents
anchor: ₹140 Cr from 10 anchors at ₹344 (40.7 lakh sh). Nippon Small Cap ₹39.4 Cr, DSP Healthcare ₹20.3 Cr, Invesco Pharma & Healthcare, UTI Healthcare, Allianz Global ₹15 Cr each, Loomis Sayles ₹11 Cr, Tata AIA ₹10 Cr, WhiteOak (3 funds). 74% to domestic MFs, mostly healthcare funds.
